commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' 2 - 5 Goal! Pau Cabanes (Villarreal) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:5.
90+8' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Pape Gueye (Villarreal). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.

90+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90+2' 2 - 4 Goal! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marko Dmitrovic into right side of the goal.
90+2' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+1' Adria Altimira (Leganes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Villarreal!
89' Referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Villarreal. Let’s see what happens!
89' PENALTY APPEAL by Villarreal, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
87' The attendance for today's match is 11034.

83' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Marko Dmitrovic anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
83' Substitution. Kiko Femenia walks off the pitch and Juan Foyth (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
82' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
82' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post!
81' The ball goes behind for a corner. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Big moment in the game as the red card awarded to Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is reduced to a yellow following the VAR review!

79' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Thierno Barry (Villarreal), but referee Alejandro Ruiz must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
78' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
77' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) is sent off by the referee for a disgraceful tackle that simply has no place in football!
76' Marcelino has decided to substitute Santi Comesana and he is replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
76' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
74' Javi Hernandez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).
73' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

72' Villarreal slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
69' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yeremy Pino trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pau Cabanes (Villarreal).
65' 2 - 3 Thierno Barry (Villarreal) finds himself in a promising position after getting on the end of a pass and fires the ball inside the left post!
63' Borja Jimenez has decided to make a change. Darko Brasanac (Leganes) replaces Dani Raba.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan Cruz (Leganes) will replace Miguel de la Fuente.
58' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
58' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
57' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
55' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' Borja Jimenez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Matija Nastasic suffers an injury and Valentin Rosier (Leganes) comes on.
52' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) picks up an injury.
49' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Marko Dmitrovic. What a save!
48' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Alex Baena (Villarreal) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
46' The game is over for Denis Suarez (Villarreal). Gerard Moreno comes on for the second half.
46' Marcelino has made a change at the break. Pau Navarro has come on in place of Logan Costa (Villarreal).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle after Pape Gueye (Villarreal) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
45+4' Junior Reis (Villarreal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+3' Junior Reis (Villarreal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marko Dmitrovic into the bottom right corner.
45+1' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle after Matija Nastasic (Leganes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Villarreal are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Leganes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
43' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
42' Alex Baena (Villarreal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
39' Dani Raba (Leganes) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alejandro Ruiz who sees an offensive foul.
36' Villarreal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
33' 2 - 1 Goal! Dani Raba (Leganes) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Junior Reis to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
33' Dani Raba (Leganes) is going to take the penalty!
32' Referee Alejandro Ruiz sees the trip by Logan Costa (Villarreal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Leganes.

29' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Marko Dmitrovic makes a comfortable save.
26' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' Alex Baena (Villarreal) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
24' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
22' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul after Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) hacks down one of his opponents.
18' Alejandro Ruiz sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
17' The Villarreal players halt their celebrations as referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
16' 1 - 1 Goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
12' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Miguel de la Fuente finds Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
4' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Leganes will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
